remarks: Six acres, multiple garages and outbuildings, room for everyone, and just minutes from Ellicottville—this is the kind of property that opens up endless possibilities. The home has been expanded well beyond its original footprint, including a massive second floor great room complete with a wood-burning fireplace and plenty of room for everyone. It's easy to picture holidays here, Bills games with friends, or warming up by the fire after a day in Ellicottville. The first-floor addition creates an entirely separate living area complete with a full bathroom and its own propane wall furnace, offering the potential for an in-law setup, private guest quarters, or flexible living space. The original living room adds even more character with a second wood-burning fireplace. Outside, nearly six acres of mostly fenced land provide plenty of room to enjoy the outdoors, while multiple garages and sheds offer exceptional storage and workspace. One of the garages offers space for multiple vehicles and has previously accommodated a lift—ideal for the car enthusiast, hobbyist, or anyone who can never seem to have enough room for vehicles and outdoor equipment. The exterior features low-maintenance vinyl siding, an asphalt roof approximately 13 years old, and a metal roof approximately 5 years old. Enjoy the privacy of country living just 10 minutes from downtown Ellicottville and 20 minutes from Springville. From summer weekends on six acres to ski season in Ellicottville, this property offers the space and versatility to enjoy every season. Square footage was measured by the listing agent.
